findings.title: Id lookup now takes precedence over title lookup, so a title can resolve to the wrong task
findings.why: `find` now tries `tasks.get(key)` before `byTitle`. `add` does not stop a title from looking like an id. Suppose a task titled "task-2" is added first, so its id is task-1, and a task "B" is added second, so its id is task-2. Then `complete('task-2')`, `remove('task-2')` and `rename('task-2', …)` act on B, not on the task actually titled "task-2". `remove` loses data this way. The docs make the title the primary key and say the id works "wherever a title is taken". Titles are unique, but the code never makes the id namespace distinct from the title namespace, for example by rejecting titles that match `task-N`. The ambiguity existed before, but the change moves it from the id side to the title side.
